ui.summary: Super-admin roles, tenant overrides, and impersonation.
ui.maturityReason: QUARANTINED: impersonation verify/end routes have no workspace-role check, so any member reaches them (attack suite ROLE_ESCALATION); super-admin powers sit inside a tenant app (risk 4)

globalTables.reason: Platform-wide super-admin registry across all workspaces
All-tenant by design: platform super-admin overrides; workspace_id names the target tenant, not the caller's workspace, and only super-admin routes read or write it (AD-V2 review, story 0.7)
All-tenant by design: support impersonation sessions are created by platform super-admins and verified by opaque session token before any workspace context exists (AD-V2 review, story 0.7)
